column1: # Validity of grid cells (N5 §3). A cell is generated only if, for every row whose `if` holds, `then` holds.
# Terms are space-separated and all must hold; key=a|b: the key has one of the values; key!=a|b: it has none.
# Keys: the dimensions of dims.tsv (block is one too); the predicate's features vol, asp, pclass (vocab feat), kind
# (verb, adj, nominal, exist; from gcls) and flag (its gflags atoms); time (the time= flags of the sentence's
# nouns); rank (the lemma's place among the vocab.tsv lemmas of its class, from 1); for two-clause lines group
# (links.tsv), and the predicate is the second one. The `limit` column of a points.tsv or links.tsv
# row adds its terms to every `then`. A dimension a block does not have takes its first value in dims.tsv order
